header: Five robots, seed position 21  ·  take 1 of 1  ·  VLM: Gemini Robotics-ER 2
camera_label: Left: real overhead camera of the simulation (topic /perception/annotated_frame). The boxes and robot ids were drawn on it by the perception module (M1) during the run.
intro_lines: Five robots run pickup-and-delivery tasks around two rack islands. When robots are stuck for 12 s, the system asks a vision-language model (VLM) what to do: it sends a text prompt and the current camera image, checks the answer, and executes it.
Robots: 5  ·  Model: Gemini Robotics-ER 2 (gemini-robotics-er-2-preview)  ·  Take 1 of 1, recorded 2026-11-15. A limitation demonstration on an exploratory seed.
Left: real overhead camera of the simulation. Right: the run's own logs, replayed in sync with simulation time.
watch_for: The model's first two decisions and how they are executed (yellow lines, then green 'action=' lines).
Where robot_3's escort takes it in the second decision.
What the check does with the later proposals (orange lines).

captions.text: Five robots drive their pickup and delivery tasks.
Trigger: robot_4 has been stuck for 12 s, nose to nose with robot_1. The system sends the model a text prompt and the current camera image; the wait for its answer plays in real time.
Model's plan (decision 1): robot_1 yields, robot_4 crosses, the others continue.
Dispatch: robot_1 is sent 'yield' and robot_4 is escorted past; robot_3 and robot_5 are told to wait (a safety shield the system adds).
Decision 1 completed: robot_4 passed robot_1. The two then stopped about 0.42 m apart and the safety monitor held them there.
Trigger: robot_1, robot_2 and robot_3 have been slow or close for 12 s. The model is asked again.
Model's plan (decision 2): robot_2 yields, robot_3 crosses, the others continue.
Dispatch: robot_2 is sent 'yield'; robot_3 will be escorted past it.
robot_2 has pulled aside; robot_3's escort drives it straight west.
Decision 2's escort drove robot_3 straight into a rack island (the escort path has no obstacle check); it stayed against the island until the escort timed out.

at.match: robot robot_5 arrived at base goal

captions.text: robot_5 reaches its first task goal.
Check: refused ('no feasible yielder': the robots it could ask to yield have 0.00 m of room to back out, 0.77 m needed). The command is withheld; nothing moves.
The sixth refusal. Nothing moves any more, so the system stops asking (no analysis after sim 275.5 s).

outcome.text: Outcome: Unresolved failure: 1 of 5 robots arrived by the end of the take (sim 600 s).

legend: Legend: yield = back out and pull aside · cross = drive past · continue = keep driving · temporary_wait = hold still · provenance: vlm_verbatim = plan accepted unchanged, repaired = edited by the verifier, m3_default = replaced by the grounding module's default plan · refusal withheld = nothing is sent · dispatch_order_source=chi = the system's own ordering · 'safety stop … min_distance_violation' (dim) = robots closer than 0.45 m are held still by the safety monitor.
disclosure: Illustrative demo, not controlled experimental evidence. Seed position 21 (exploratory extension seed).
outro_title: Outcome: Unresolved failure  ·  take 1 of 1 (limitation demonstration)
outro_lines: 1 of 5 robots arrived (robot_5, at its first task goal).
The model's: decision 1 (robot_1 yields, robot_4 passes) and decision 2 (robot_2 yields, robot_3 passes), both executed as named.

The system's: the waits added as a safety shield; the escort paths; the safety monitor holding robots closer than 0.45 m; the six refusals of later proposals (no feasible yielder ×4, no declared junction, no shared lane), all withheld.

Decision 2's escort drove robot_3 straight into a rack island (the escort path has no obstacle check); it stayed against the island until the escort timed out. So 'unresolved' partly reflects this escort path error, not only the model's decisions or the later refusals.
Seed position 21 (exploratory extension seed); shows a current limitation.
